scope: Phase 5/6 integration: core.Open now mounts the shell, home screen, admin page and help center, the marketplace client side and the module runtime on one pool and one handler, with the admin Modules and marketplace tab, module panels on the matter screen, module sidebar entries, module-facing routes and core.events from billing and practice. status pass means every assigned phase case passed at the tested revision, plus the local scripts listed in tests. It is not full product acceptance: 21 of 52 criteria remain pending globally, including AC-012, AC-014, AC-033, AC-036 and AC-037 whose phase case passes with the gaps named in pending_notes. Checkpoint fix at this revision: the supervisor now serves PUT and DELETE /v1/modules/{name}, so an installed module gets its container in the Compose stack's Docker engine (tested on a real engine with the Matter Clock image pulled by registry digest). Not run locally: scripts/ci/test-core.sh end to end (needs the LawCraft core image build), the QA harness, Backup integration and the Supervisor image jobs; their results come from the pull request's Product CI run.
